notes: Round 6 (puppets_r6, 1.3M decisions; sandbox_r1, 270k decisions on the ragdolls). Puppets: the wolves killed six deer per 20k decisions at the start of the round and one at its end, as the deer learned to keep away; they began to eat (Feed mode 23% to 31%, feeding 1% to 2% of the time) and 96% still starve. Ragdolls: the wolves wound and kill with their heads (one kill per summary, 2.4 healths of wounds), their walkers learned not to overrun the command (1.85 to 1.1 of the speed asked) and fall five times less; a life went from 66 s to 190 s, 92% starve. Round 7: nothing in the hunt changed; the meal is paid by what is eaten (eat 6) so that standing by a carcass in Feed mode without the muzzle on it is not the better deal, gnaw halved; mating as for the deer.

terms.name: pair
terms.expr: 0.2 * adult * (1 - pregnant) * step(energy - 0.6) * mode_mate * step(3 - mate_distance)
